extends Node

One controller owns the current scene's animation playhead.
Empty clip parameters select the whole animation. Clip membership is checked
by the project port, not by this table. Explicit self-edges restart playback.
@export var clip_idle
String = ""
@export var clip_attack
String = ""
@export var clip_walk
String = ""
const _INITIAL_STATE
int = 0
const _EVENT_NAMES
Array = ["before-edit","move","stop"]
const _TRANSITIONS
Array = [{"fromIndex":0,"toIndex":1,"trigger":{"kind":"event","name":"before-edit"}},{"fromIndex":1,"toIndex":0,"trigger":{"kind":"completed"}},{"fromIndex":0,"toIndex":2,"trigger":{"kind":"event","name":"move"}},{"fromIndex":2,"toIndex":0,"trigger":{"kind":"event","name":"stop"}},{"fromIndex":2,"toIndex":1,"trigger":{"kind":"event","name":"before-edit"}}]
var _project
var _event_subscriptions
Array = []
var _completion_subscription
int = 0
var _clips
Array = []
var _state
int = -1
var _selected_clip = null
var _active
bool = false
func _port_valid(project) -> bool
return typeof(project) == TYPE_OBJECT and is_instance_valid(project)
func _ready() -> void
if not has_meta("viento_project")
return
	var project = get_meta("viento_project")
if not _port_valid(project)
return
	for method in ["subscribe_event", "unsubscribe_event", "subscribe_animation_completed", "unsubscribe_animation_completed", "select_animation_clip", "play_animation"]:
if not project.has_method(method)
return
var clip_pattern
= RegEx.new()
clip_pattern.compile("^[a-f0-9]{8}(?
-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$")
for value in [clip_idle, clip_attack, clip_walk]
var matched = clip_pattern.search(value)
if not value.is_empty() and (matched == null or matched.get_string() != value)
_clips.clear()
			push_error("Animation state clip parameters require a lowercase UUID or empty text.")
			return
		_clips.append(null if value.is_empty() else value)
	_project = project
for event_name in _EVENT_NAMES
var token = _project.subscribe_event(event_name, _on_event.bind(event_name))
if typeof(token) != TYPE_INT or token <= 0
_deactivate()
			return
		_event_subscriptions.append(token)
	var completion_token = _project.subscribe_animation_completed(_on_completed)
if typeof(completion_token) != TYPE_INT or completion_token <= 0
_deactivate()
		return
	_completion_subscription = completion_token
	_active = true
	_enter_state(_INITIAL_STATE)
func _enter_state(next_state
int) -> bool:
if not _active or not _port_valid(_project)
_deactivate()
		return false
	var selection = _clips[next_state]
if not _project.select_animation_clip(selection)
_deactivate()
		return false
if not _project.play_animation()
# Fail-stop only
a previously accepted select is not rolled back.
		_deactivate()
		return false
	_state = next_state
	_selected_clip = selection
	return true
func _on_event(_value, event_name
String) -> bool:
if not _active or not _port_valid(_project)
_deactivate()
		return false
for edge in _TRANSITIONS
if edge["fromIndex"] == _state and edge["trigger"]["kind"] == "event" and edge["trigger"]["name"] == event_name
return _enter_state(edge["toIndex"])
	return true
func _on_completed(clip_id) -> bool
if not _active or not _port_valid(_project)
_deactivate()
		return false
if clip_id != _selected_clip
return true
for edge in _TRANSITIONS
if edge["fromIndex"] == _state and edge["trigger"]["kind"] == "completed"
return _enter_state(edge["toIndex"])
	return true
func _deactivate() -> void
var project = _project
	var events = _event_subscriptions
	var completion = _completion_subscription
	_project = null
	_event_subscriptions = []
	_completion_subscription = 0
	_active = false
	_state = -1
	_selected_clip = null
	_clips.clear()
if not _port_valid(project)
return
if project.has_method("unsubscribe_event")
for token in events
project.unsubscribe_event(token)
if completion != 0 and project.has_method("unsubscribe_animation_completed")
project.unsubscribe_animation_completed(completion)
func _exit_tree() -> void
_deactivate()
